# Teecanva

> Teecanva is a custom apparel and design studio in Forney, Texas, serving the Dallas–Fort Worth area. It designs custom group shirts for schools, teams, churches, and organizations, handles bulk printing, and delivers to campuses and events. It also sells educator shirt-design bundles as instant downloads.

## Key facts

- Business: Teecanva — Custom Apparel & Design Studio
- Founded: February 2019
- Location: Forney, Texas, serving Dallas–Fort Worth (including Dallas, Fort Worth, Garland, Mesquite, Terrell, Balch Springs, and Kaufman County)
- Founder: Abiuth Maronga, Founder & Designer; SPED Substitute Teacher with Dallas ISD
- Website: https://teecanva.com/
- Contact: print@teecanva.com, (602) 299-2832
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/officialteecanva/
- Etsy shop (design bundles): https://www.etsy.com/shop/TeecanvaStudio

## Services

- Custom group shirts: full service — design, pre-order collection, bulk printing, and delivery. Organizers do not handle inventory or chase payments.
- Custom design service: $95 per custom design, waived on orders of 50+ shirts. Includes 1–2 concepts within 3 days and one revision round.
- Design bundles (Etsy): ready-made educator shirt designs as SVG + transparent PNG downloads.
  - SPED Teacher Pack: 20 designs
  - Teacher Life Pack: 25 designs
  - Support Staff Pack: 15 designs
- Corporate / bulk orders: quote first, proof to approve, PO or invoice payment, tax-exempt handling for schools on request, and print-ready files delivered at the end. See https://teecanva.com/corporate.html

## Bulk pricing (starting prices; final quote depends on garment, colors, and print locations)

- 24–49 shirts: from $14 per shirt
- 50–99 shirts: from $12 per shirt
- 100+ shirts: from $10 per shirt
- Design fee: $95, waived on 50+ shirt orders
- Every quote is free.

## How it works

1. Tell Teecanva your idea: group name, occasion, and rough headcount.
2. Receive 1–2 design concepts within 3 days, with one revision round included.
3. Collect orders with a simple order form shared with the group; no money up front from the organizer.
4. Bulk printing locally, delivered to campus or event in about two weeks.

## Frequently asked questions

- Minimum order: Screen printing starts at 12 shirts; pricing improves meaningfully at 24+.
- Turnaround: About two weeks from order close to delivery; design concepts within 3 days. Rush production is available on request.
- Payments: For group orders, each person orders and pays individually through a shared order link; the organizer does not front money.
- Colors: School and team colors can be matched on bulk orders.
- Delivery: Local delivery across Dallas–Fort Worth, including direct to campus or event; shipping elsewhere in the US is available on request.
- Reorders: Screens and artwork are kept on file, so reorders skip setup.
- Bundle file formats: SVG vectors plus transparent PNGs at 300 DPI.
- Bundle licenses: Personal covers shirts and gifts for yourself; Commercial lets you sell up to 200 physical end-products made with the designs.
